hypothesis: Intra-kernel GROUP_M=4 L2 swizzle with fixed 64x128x32 tiles will outperform direct 2D pid ordering on 512x3072x768 FP16 without changing math.
expected_mechanism: Remapping linear pid into groups of 4 M-tiles x all N-tiles keeps CTAs that reuse the same A block close in launch order, improving L2 hit rate and reducing DRAM traffic for the large-N dimension. Math, masks, FP32 accumulation, single launch, and tile sizes are unchanged; only execution order changes, so boundary correctness is preserved.
reasoning_from_feedback: Prior structural screening showed grouped_m4 promising_unconfirmed at ~1.005x while split_k factor 2 hurt at ~0.836x, so this proposal internalizes GROUP_M=4 ordering inside the kernel to keep the fixed launcher and single launch while avoiding K-parallel reduction. Previous rejection was AnnAssign syntax, so this version uses only plain assignments and standard tl ops with identical baseline signature.
